MECH_NOTHING: This vehicle has nothing to fit here
MECH_KIT_DONE: The engine runs again, get it to a mechanic
MECH_KIT_OUTSIDE: Get out of the vehicle first
MECH_KIT_NOT_NEEDED: The engine does not need a repair kit
MECH_ERR_FAR: You are not at the right place
MECH_ERR_JOB: Only on-duty members of this shop can work here
MECH_ERR_BILL: The bill could not be sent
MECH_ERR_BILL_JOB: Only on-duty mechanics can bill customers
MECH_ERR_BILL_TARGET: That player cannot get a bill
MECH_ERR_BILL_FAR: The customer is too far away
ADMIN_TAB_SHOPS_DESC: Places where drivers repair and tune their vehicles, open to everyone or run by a job.
ADMIN_C_SHOP_DESC: Where the shop is and what it offers. Drivers open it from the driver seat inside the area.
ADMIN_H_COORDS: The middle of the workshop floor.
ADMIN_H_RADIUS: How far from the place a vehicle can be served.
ADMIN_H_REPAIR: Fixes engine and body; the price follows the damage.
ADMIN_H_TUNING: Performance, body parts, wheels, paint, tint, plate and lights.
ADMIN_H_MULTIPLIER: Every price here is multiplied by this (1 = the prices in Settings).
ADMIN_C_JOB_DESC: A job shop serves only that job's on-duty members and charges the job's account; its staff bill the customers.
ADMIN_H_JOB: Empty: a public shop, the driver pays.
ADMIN_H_STASH: A shared stash for the job's members. Leave at 0, 0, 0 for none.
ADMIN_TAB_WASHES_DESC: Places where a driver pays to wash the vehicle.
ADMIN_C_WASH_DESC: Drive in and press the prompt.
ADMIN_H_WASH_COORDS: The middle of the wash lane.
ADMIN_C_PRICES_DESC: Base prices; each shop multiplies them by its own multiplier.
ADMIN_H_ACCOUNTS: Public shops and car washes take the money from the first account that has enough.
ADMIN_H_REPAIR_POINT: A wrecked vehicle has up to 2000 damage points (engine and body).
ADMIN_H_PERFORMANCE: Engine, brakes, transmission, suspension and armor: level 1 costs this, level 2 twice this, and so on.
ADMIN_H_COSMETIC: Every spoiler, bumper, hood and other part.
ADMIN_C_WASHING_DESC: What a wash costs and how long it takes.
ADMIN_C_KIT_DESC: The repair kit item, used on foot next to a vehicle.
ADMIN_H_KIT_ENGINE: 1000 is a new engine; below 300 it smokes, at 0 it stops.
ADMIN_H_KIT_ITEM: The item players use as a repair kit.
ADMIN_C_BILLS_DESC: On-duty members of a job shop's job bill the player next to them from the radial menu; the job's account gets the money when the customer pays.
ADMIN_H_BILL_MIN: The least a mechanic can ask for in one bill.
ADMIN_H_BILL_MAX: The most a mechanic can ask for in one bill.
ADMIN_ERR_BILL_RANGE: The smallest bill cannot be larger than the largest bill.
ADMIN_C_STASH_DESC: Size of the shared stash in every job shop.
ADMIN_C_BLIPS_DESC: How shops and car washes look on the map.
ADMIN_DELETE_SHOP_DESC: Its stash stays in the inventory database.
